note: Small family-run RV park in the woods off I-40, a short drive from the BlueOval City plant; mostly longer stays: of its seven RV sites, one is sold by the night online and the rest go by phone. --Claude
summary: Private, 7 RV sites + 1 tent; $40 + 8% booking fee ($43.20) on every date quoted, under the gate; 30/50 A, water, sewer, laundry, showers, wifi; year-round; 10% military. Long-stay character: only Site 6 of 7 is bookable online. Google 4.8/70; RV Life $40-45 stays 9-10/2026. Phone, website and pin unchanged.
flags: LONG-STAY (caveat band, not a drop): the operator markets 'Close to Blue Oval' and stays 'for work'; on ParkWithUs only Site 6 of RV Sites 1-7 is bookable (Sites 1-5 and 7 is_bookable false), i.e. 1 of 7 (~14%) sold nightly online - passes test 4 at the 10-50% caveat band, note says it.
